main_text.head: IOH. FRIDERICI FAVSTI AB ASCHAFFENBVRGO, PATRICII ET SENATORIS FRANCOFORDIANI, ODE AD MELCHIOREM HAIMINSFELDIVM GOLDASTVM.
main_text.p: [?]Inon minori laude vehendus est, Inuenta quisquis sedulus excolit, Formaque donat, atque lucis Perspicuæ probitate vestit. Næ clariori laude vehendus est, Qui scripta, longi conscia temporis, At pressa tristibus tenebris, Eruit atque situ repurgat. Vtinde seris magna nepotibus Virtus parentum, factaque fortia, Cultusque constent literarum, Obsequiis imitanda pulchris. Id tu reponis dotibus ingeni HAIMSFELDIANI gloria sanguinis, Reddisque luci, quæ tenebris Obruta delituere multis. Sic, macte famâ, vindicias age Feré sepultæ laudis, & optumum Serua decus peritioris Teutoniæ, calamo perenni. O si diebus præteritis, patrum Fuisset hæc industria, curaque, Non erudita tot virorum Scripta nigris tegerentur vmbris: Nec facta ficta, fortis & inclutæ Germaniæ, caligine perderet, Sed campo inglorius Notator Iulius eiiceretur omni.

page.notes: The first letter S is a large woodcut initial, transcribed as "I" plus "non" is the printed first word "Inon" resolved as "Non" with the initial; the initial letter is uncertain. Lines are printed as verse; each stanza-like block is one paragraph. Words in the verse with doubtful letters are marked [?].
